fixes.what: The 1635 gain of Martapura (30 km round Muara Kaman) falls mostly outside every keyframe drawn after it, and it does not explain how K0 grows into K1.
fixes.why: Taking the author's own Muara Kaman coordinates (116.7 E, 0.2 S, from the report hint), the 30 km disc covers 11 cells, and 8 of them (about 2,020 km2) lie outside Cliopatria's 1648 outline, whose north edge is at 0.31 S. K1 (1635-1647) is that outline unchanged, and K2-K5 are 'ok' or change only the years. So the ledger has Kutai holding Martapura's centre from 1635 to 1844 while no keyframe draws it. Also, K0 (5 cells, about 1,260 km2, round Kutai Lama) becomes K1 (28 cells, about 7,080 km2), and no event covers 20 of the 23 added cells. Sultanate page: 'In 1635, the Kingdom of Kutai Kartanegara defeated the Kingdom of Kutai Martapura', which was 'centered in Muara Kaman'.
fixes.fix: Make the keyframes and the ledger tell one story. Option (a): set K1-K5 to verdict adjust with correction {union: [Cliopatria shape, Muara Kaman 30 km]}, and make the 1635 gain region {union: [{minus: [{cliopatria: 'Kutai Kingdom', year: 1648}, Kutai Lama 20 km]}, Muara Kaman 30 km]}. Option (b): state in K1's correction text that Cliopatria's outline is the united realm, and make the gain region {minus: [{cliopatria: 'Kutai Kingdom', year: 1648}, Kutai Lama 20 km]}, dropping the disc that lies outside.

fixes.why: Sultanate page lead: the sultanate 'originated from the Hindu Kingdom of Martapura founded in 1300 at Kutai Lama'. Body: 'The Kingdom of Kutai Kartanegara was founded in the 14th century in the area of Kutai Lama'. Kutai page: 'established around the end of the 13th century', with the first ruler at 1300-1325. The year 1300 stays at confidence 2 on the Kutai page.
fixes.fix: Reworded both notes to give what each page actually says. The year, the region and the confidence are unchanged. Re-validated: 0 errors.
